notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed. The fake backend is the package's own pure Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py) for the constructor's default task_assignment world; gym and pybullet were not installed where the gate ran, so the fake was not compared with the upstream environment and the sim backend (gymnasium.make, then legacy gym.make) was not run. The upstream registers recon-arena-v0 with legacy gym, so that sim path only resolves through the bridge's gym fallback when gymnasium is not importable. The default setup is covered (1 Tello, 1 RoboMaster, 2 adversaries, 1 neutral, 0 obstacles); other setups, tracking, reward_b and reward_c, ray-cast visibility and rendering are not exercised. The five warnings are the expected Gymnasium-family warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 and four G8.NO_UNIT for integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.values and seed twice); there are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
